description: Ask a shopping question; the answer recommends only deals our editors published (or says none fits), with the deal records it relied on. Prices come from records, not from the answer text. Each deal starts with summary_one_line (quote it as written). Cite canonical_url, buy via go_url (unchanged), and always give price.as_of and check.state (verified_fresh, as_posted, stale, price_changed, out_of_stock, unpriced, expired: see methodology_url). Savings appear only against a verified reference.
name: ask_deal_room
title: Ask PostThisDeal’s Black Friday deal room
